yaml:
format: 1
vars:
  spec_version: "2026-10-24.3"
flows:
  login:
    - id: token
      type: request
      method: POST
      url: "https://oregonpsilocybinprodb2c.b2clogin.com/token"
      form: {email: "{{email}}", password: "{{password}}"}
      extract:
        - {var: access_token, source: body, json: access_token}
  renew:
    - id: token
      type: request
      method: POST
      url: "https://oregonpsilocybinprodb2c.b2clogin.com/token"
      form: {refresh_token: "{{refresh_token}}"}
      extract:
        - {var: access_token, source: body, json: access_token}
